thread:
alex: Quick check — where are we on the pricing change implementation? Need clear owners for metering ingest, billing export, quota enforcement, and any contract constraints. Target: beta rollout in 2 weeks. Any blockers?

samir: Metering ingest: PR is up (PR: `github.com/redwood/inference/pull/412`), in review. Waiting on infra signoff for autoscaler config. ETA end of week. @jen can you take a look?

jen: Looking now. Autoscaler change requires one prod-safe test (scale-to-zero scenario). If that passes, can approve by Friday. :crossed_fingers:

chen: Billing export: schema change landed in staging but billing pipeline needs the sample invoice rows from contracts to validate aggregation. Also we found a corner-case with hourly plans vs monthly proration.

maria: I can generate sample invoices today. Quick question: do we need separate plan IDs for discounted enterprise tiers or can we map discounts at billing time? If separate IDs, I need the mapping matrix.

alex: We should use separate plan ids where price/limits differ. Samir, does metering emit plan IDs today?

samir: Metering emits a `plan_id` tag for usage events, but the gateway ratecard lookup still needs to join on plan_id. I can wire that up, but I'll need the matrix from contracts.

maria: OK — I'll produce the mapping matrix by EOD and note contract constraints. Also flag: contracts require minimum billing period logic, so proration needs to be nailed down.

priya: Rollout ask: canary to 5% customers, watch billing delta and quota misses. Need a rollback toggle in Console and a dashboard for billing diffs. Is that doable before beta?

jen: Console feature-flag toggle is straightforward. We'll add a small telemetry counter for quota misses and surface it on the per-route dashboard.

tom: SRE notes: add alert for billing export failures + backfill job for missed windows. Suggest daily incremental backfill that can fill gaps up to 30 days. Also want runbook for investigators.

alex: Owners recap: metering ingest — @samir; autoscaler/infra — @jen; billing export + schema check — @chen; contracts/matrix — @maria; rollout & monitoring — @priya; SRE alerts/backfill — @tom. Everyone good with that?

samir: Good for me — I'll post the PR link and assign reviewers this afternoon.

chen: I'll package sample invoice rows and post them to the staging bucket, pinging @maria.

maria: Matrix + contract note uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.dev/pricing/plan-mapping (placeholder). Please review when you can.

alex: Thanks team. I'll update the project tracker and schedule daily 15-min standups until go-live. If you hit blockers, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
